info.text:
In August 2026, the median condo cost $63,200 less than the median house.

NAR medians: $434,800 single-family vs $371,600 condo/co-op (14.5% less).
Hypothetical 20% down, 7%, 30 years: about $2,314 vs $1,978 a month, a $336 difference.
A hypothetical $400 HOA fee more than erases it. In 2024, about 3 million households paid $500+ a month in condo/HOA fees (Census).

Sources: NAR (Aug 2026); Freddie Mac PMMS (Sept 2026); U.S. Census Bureau (Sept 2025).
News and education, not financial advice.
